name: ACE-Step
tagline: Open-source foundation model that turns text prompts into original, high-quality music.

pricing.basis: not applicable - the model is open source and free
pricing.notes: Apache-2.0 licensed foundation model; no paid tier. Running your own inference costs GPU time.
pricing.freeTier: Entire model is free and open source under Apache-2.0.

verdictSummary: ACE-Step is not a wrapper you can prompt your way around - it IS the model. An Apache-2.0 music generation foundation model you run yourself; the value is the weights plus the GPU time behind them.
moatNotes: It is the model itself, open sourced - there is nothing to replace it with; you would just run ACE-Step.
notes: Open-source music generation foundation model (Apache-2.0, ~5k stars). Free already.
